spots.blurb: You've reached Maps and Maping: The Firefighter's Life Line, a mural by Eric Powell from 2011. Artist Eric Powell designed custom laser-cut steel gates, based on a bird’s eye view of the neighborhood street layouts. Maps are crucial and essential part of successful firefighting.
